effective_date_basis: Effective date of the revoking instrument per tract; or a current basis through 2026-10-14.
ending_pattern: Land withdrawal for water-power or reservoir purposes: continues until revoked, modified or vacated by a later order or Public Land Order, and, for lands reserved for power purposes, until otherwise directed by the Federal Power Commission or Congress (Federal Power Act s.24, 16 U.S.C. 818). Restoration orders diminish it.

exceptions_savings.assessment: Valid existing rights; licences under the Federal Power Act. Federal Power Act s.24 is an independent statutory basis and limits what counts as an end (restoration needs a Commission determination and may reserve a right of re-entry). FLPMA (Pub. L. 94-579, Oct. 21, 1976) s.704(a) repealed the Pickett Act and implied withdrawal authority prospectively; s.701 saves existing withdrawals until modified under FLPMA or other law (IBLA, Grant L. Hacking, 1980). This is a continuity point, never an end; the s.204(l) review of withdrawals is a review lead, not an end.

legal_effect: Research pattern only. A type rule never fills a judgment field, establishes an end, a date, a status or savings for any order, and never substitutes for reading the order's own text.
outlier_conditions: The order's own text (not only the WPA summary or APP title) does not match the type, or the held text is another order's.
The order does more than the type's single act (a second operative clause of another kind).
A later order or statute amends, extends, revokes or revives it before the candidate end.
The order states its own effective date, duration, condition or termination that differs from the pattern.
The order itself is a restoration (it ends a part of another order rather than creating a reserve).
Lands reserved automatically under FPA s.24 by a filed application, with no executive order.
Restoration subject to FPA s.24 conditions.
The order itself is a restoration (it ends part of another order rather than creating a reserve).
